title: LIST OF COAS COMMENDATION CARD AWARDEES
body_text:
List of COAS Commendation Card awardees on the occasion of Independence Day 2026 is enclosed. Attached file :- List of pers being Awarded COAS Commendation Card Aug 2026.
****
Nishant/ Rinku Singh

enrichment.summary: The Press Information Bureau released the list of Army personnel awarded the Chief of Army Staff (COAS) Commendation Card on the occasion of Independence Day 2026. The announcement consists of an attached list of awardees without further details in the release text itself.
enrichment.context: The COAS Commendation Card is a recognition given by the Indian Army to personnel for meritorious service, distinguished conduct, or exceptional contribution to their duties. Such commendations are traditionally announced twice a year, around Republic Day and Independence Day, as part of the broader tradition of honouring service members. These are administrative/ceremonial announcements and do not reflect any policy change, new scheme, or strategic development within the Ministry of Defence.

related_articles.relationship: Both are Army Commendation Card award lists released on the same Independence Day 2026 occasion, differing only in the awarding authority (VCOAS vs COAS).
